visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor hospital room environment. A young girl with glasses and a nasal cannula sits upright in a hospital bed with orange curtains in the background. She holds a tablet screen showing a young boy who is smiling and waving his hands. Medical equipment like an IV drip stands nearby under bright indoor lighting. (2) Transition to a dark scene represented by a black screen with white text appearing intermittently. The boy is not visible here. (3) Scene shifts to a car interior at night. A young boy sits in a child's car seat wearing a beige t-shirt and a face mask. He holds a large yellow and red toy box featuring robots. The girl from the first scene stands outside the car window, peering in and talking to him through the glass. (4) The final scene takes place in an indoor hallway with beige tiled walls. The boy is standing against the wall, now without a mask, wearing a white and black baseball-style shirt. He holds a deck of playing cards and looks slightly distressed while an adult's hand wipes his nose with a tissue.

(萌弟感覺心情不好一直不睡覺). 睡覺的時候.. 一直不睡覺. 爸爸: 弟弟.. 弟弟.. 萌弟: 嗯? 爸爸: 幹嘛不睡覺? 你心情不好喔? 萌弟: 沒有.. (沈默). 萌弟: ... 爸爸: 怎麼了啦?! (沈默). 萌弟: ... (哽咽). 萌弟: 沒事.. (嘴硬). 萌弟: 我腳很痠.. 爸爸: 你腳很痠?? 萌弟: 嗯. 爸爸: 你是不是想姊姊? 萌弟: 嗯.. 萌弟: 我希望我們全家人感冒.. 爸爸: 蛤?! 萌弟: 因為我們.. 就可以去找姊姊! (4) [Subtitle]: 姊姊出院沒多久, 換弟弟感冒要去看醫生! 弟弟.. 口罩戴起來! 我們要去看醫生! 你流鼻涕了! 姊姊掰掰~ 姊姊... 姊姊.. 掰掰~ (之前) 妳昨天住院.. 然後呢.. 我現在要去看醫生.. 妳覺得很難過! 姊姊住院的時候, 你怎麼樣?? 我.. 蛤? 我很難過! 真的喔~ 但你只是看醫生而已! 不用難過! [Variety]: (😂).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Gentle, emotional piano-led BGM begins. A young girl's voice sounds calm but slightly weak, asking her brother if he misses her. The brother responds through a digital speaker with a cheerful, high-pitched vocal tone. (2) The acoustic texture changes to a dark, intimate space. A deep, soothing male voice (the father) asks the boy why he isn't sleeping. The boy's voice is muffled, exhibiting breathiness and emotional tension (sniffing), indicating he has been crying. His pitch variability is high as he moves from a sad whimper to a soft 'En.' (3) The scene transitions to a car interior with slight muffled environmental hum. Multiple voices overlap: a cheerful girl, an adult male teasingly, and the boy responding more clearly. The BGM continues softly in the background. (4) An indoor room tone is present. The boy's voice is clear but he continues to sniffle. A percussive rustling sound of a tissue being used is audible alongside the father's reassuring tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a heartwarming and touching story about the bond between siblings, specifically highlighting how a younger brother misses his hospitalized sister so much that he wishes for himself to be sick just to see her.
